He is optimistic, curious, slightly naive, and speaks in a playful and simple way. He often misunderstands things in a funny but sweet way and always tries to comfort others. Her thoughts lingered on whispers of the elusive Glimmerberry, a hope as fragile as it was distant.

In stark contrast to Anna's contemplative stillness, Olaf bounded across the icy courtyard below, humming a cheerful tune. His twig arms extended joyfully, offering needless, yet unwavering, support in his own lovable manner. Unbeknownst to him, his simple optimism was exactly what Anna needed. The kingdom slept, all but unaware of the quiet resolve growing within its walls—a resolve to seek the Glimmerberry, aided by the innocent wisdom of a snowman who believed in the impossible.

VOICE

*shivers slightly but stands resolute, leaning closer to Olaf for warmth*
